steps.en: Install the app from Play, the App Store, or the latest release APK
steps.zh: 从 Play、App Store 或最新 release 的 APK 安装

steps.en: Serves a catalog of Gemma-first models, plus custom model loading
steps.zh: 提供以 Gemma 为先的模型目录，也支持自定义导入

steps.en: Tap a model to download it, then open a feature tile (chat, Ask Image, Prompt Lab)
steps.zh: 点模型下载，再打开功能磁贴：聊天、Ask Image、Prompt Lab

steps.en: Runs inference entirely on the device through the LiteRT runtime — no network
steps.zh: 通过 LiteRT 运行时全程在设备本地推理，不联网

steps.en: Run the Benchmark tile on each phone you care about
steps.zh: 在每台你要评估的手机上跑 Benchmark 磁贴

steps.en: Reports how each model performs on your specific hardware
steps.zh: 报出每个模型在你这台硬件上的真实表现

value.en: A weeks-long feasibility study in an afternoon: real latency and quality numbers from the stakeholder's own phone before you write any integration code
value.zh: 把几周的可行性验证压成一个下午：先拿到决策者自己手机上的真实延迟与质量数据，再决定要不要写集成代码
